notes: NTU-administered pool of donor-funded merit/need-based scholarships for current undergraduates or freshmen. The official NTU page lists only the Office of Admissions / Student & Academic Services as the administering office; no professor, faculty member or research supervisor is tied to this undergraduate financial-aid scholarship. Live-checked the official source page (ntu.edu.sg).

KTH Scholarship is a tuition-fee scholarship open to applicants of all KTH two-year master's programmes. The official KTH page names no professor or supervisor; page responsible is 'KTH International Student Recruitment' (an administrative office, not a named individual). Not a research-degree award, so no supervision relationship exists.

Malmö University Master's Scholarship is a merit-based tuition-fee waiver for non-EU/EEA students admitted to any English-taught master's programme. The official mau.se scholarships page names no professor or supervisor; the only published contact is the administrative tuition-fee office (tuitionfees@mau.se), which is not a supervising academic.

Lund University ARUA Scholarship is a merit-based tuition-fee scholarship (up to 90% of tuition) for students from ARUA member universities, applicable to any international degree programme at Lund as first choice. The official Lund page names no professor, supervisor or programme-specific faculty; selection runs in parallel with admissions with no named academic contact.

KTH India Scholarship covers tuition plus a living allowance for one Indian citizen admitted to a two-year KTH master's programme. The official KTH page names no professor or supervisor; page responsible is 'KTH International Student Recruitment' (administrative office). No supervision relationship exists for this taught-master's scholarship.

EPFL Bachelor Excellence Fellowships are merit fellowships for Swiss maturity-diploma holders starting any EPFL Bachelor programme. The official EPFL page states selected candidates present before 'a jury of EPFL professors' but names no individual professor, supervisor or lab. Contact is the EPFL AVP-E SPE office, not a named academic.

SNSF Starting Grants are a national (Swiss) career-funding scheme: the applicant proposes and leads an independent project and team at a host institution of their choice. There is no attached institution and no supervising professor tied to the scheme itself (analogous to DAAD/MEXT-type national schemes). Official source: snf.ch.
